params.message:
Chassis lookup answers within the request limit and always says what happened

Production stops a web request after 30 seconds. VWE (no timeout), AutoConnect (30 s) and CarWizard
(30 s) could together outlast it; when AutoConnect was slow the request was killed, the browser got a
504 and the modal showed nothing. The three calls now share a 24-second budget, every refusal answers
one sentence in one shape, and the modal shows a failure through one renderer, also without JSON.

Closes #1111
